explanation.zh: 训练利用已有样本调整模型参数，使模型学习数据中的模式。训练效果好不代表对新数据一定表现好，需要独立验证。
explanation.en: Training uses existing examples to adjust model parameters so the model learns patterns in data. Good training performance does not guarantee good performance on new data; independent validation is needed.

examples.zh: 用过去的订单记录学习需求规律，之后用未参与训练的时段检验。
examples.en: Learn demand patterns from past order records, then evaluate on a period not used in training.

evidence.quote: In machine learning, learning involves adjusting the parameters of an ML model.
models should not be evaluated on the same data they're trained on.

explanation.zh: 历史数据反映过去的条件。要用独立数据检验模型能否处理未见情况，并留意未来环境与历史数据是否不同。
explanation.en: Historical data reflects past conditions. Use independent data to test whether a model can handle unseen cases, and watch for differences between future conditions and historical data.

examples.zh: 用过去节日销量训练的模型，遇到新的促销方式时仍需监测。
examples.en: A model trained on past holiday sales still needs monitoring when new promotion methods are introduced.

evidence.quote: degradation of machine learning model performance due to changes in data or in the relationships between input and output variables.
models should not be evaluated on the same data they're trained on.

explanation.zh: 训练数据用于学习，独立验证或测试用于检验未见样本的表现。把测试答案带入训练会让结果显得过于乐观。
explanation.en: Training data is used for learning; independent validation or testing assesses performance on unseen examples. Bringing test answers into training makes results look overly optimistic.

examples.zh: 不要将上线测试工单的标准答案直接放进待评估模型的输入。
examples.en: Do not directly include the reference answers for deployment test tickets in the input to the model being evaluated.

evidence.quote: models should not be evaluated on the same data they're trained on.

title.en: Evidence review for a new warehouse

brief.zh: 目标：从实际资料使用记录判断评价是否独立、环境是否匹配，再计算这批证据的正确率。先回看训练、泛化与验证知识；不是按文件名或已给的顺序操作。
brief.en: Goal: use data-use records to judge independence and context fit, then calculate accuracy on that evidence. Review training, generalization and evaluation first; do not follow file names or a supplied sequence.

prompt.zh: 演练：模型v7用于新仓库的同类包装检查。三份日志如下。把每份记录放到最直接反映其证据边界的区域；不是选最高分。甲：旧仓库同类任务，模型发布后才取样，18/20正确，未回流调整权重。乙：文件名“新仓库测试”，20/20正确；工程日志记载它的错误和人工答案用于更新v7权重。丙：新仓库同类任务，答案由评估员封存至v7冻结后，18/24正确；本次权重调整未接触这批资料或答案。所有数量及记录为本题演练条件。
prompt.en: Exercise: model v7 will inspect comparable packaging at a new warehouse. Classify the evidence boundary in each log, rather than pick the highest score. A: the old warehouse, sampled after release, 18/20 correct, with no weight-update feedback. B: a file named new-warehouse test scores 20/20; engineering logs say its errors and human answers were used to update v7 weights. C: the new warehouse; evaluators sealed answers until v7 was frozen, scoring 18/24, and fitting did not access those records or answers. All counts and records are exercise assumptions.

text.zh: 已影响本次模型，不能证明未见表现
text.en: Influenced this model; not unseen-case evidence

text.zh: 未影响本次模型，但环境证据还不匹配
text.en: Did not influence this model, but context evidence differs

text.zh: 可评价本次模型在目标用途的这批表现
text.en: Can evaluate this model on these target-use records

reason.zh: 先核对资料是否影响当前参数，再核对它能支持哪个环境的结论。文件名和最高分不能代替两项证据检查。甲可作旧环境对照，乙已影响当前权重，丙支持本题目标用途的一次独立评价。
reason.en: Check whether records affected the current parameters, then which context the evidence supports. File names and highest scores replace neither check. A is an old-context comparison, B affected current weights, and C supports one independent target-use evaluation.

prompt.zh: 只核算刚确认可用于本次新仓库独立评价的那份记录：正确率百分数是多少，错误记录有多少条？不汇总三份日志，不取最高分。本题没有给上线阈值，计算结果不单独构成上线许可。
prompt.en: For only the record just found suitable for this independent new-warehouse evaluation, enter accuracy as a percentage and the number of errors. Do not pool all three records or pick the highest score. No deployment threshold is given; this calculation alone is not deployment approval.

label.zh: 这批记录的正确率（百分数，不带%）

reason.zh: 丙18/24×100%=75%，24−18=6条错误。乙虽显示100%，但不能作本次独立证据；不能把甲乙丙混算，也不能凭75%编造一个未给出的上线阈值。
reason.en: C gives 18/24×100%=75% and 24−18=6 errors. B displays 100% but is not independent evidence here. Do not pool A/B/C or invent a deployment threshold from 75%.

p.zh: 甲虽然没参与权重调整，但记录来自旧仓库。它能提供旧环境的独立表现，不能单独代替新仓库证据。
p.en: A was not used to adjust weights, but its records come from the old warehouse. It supports independent old-context performance, not the new warehouse on its own.

q.zh: 乙的误差被用来修改当前权重。即使文件叫“测试”，也不能再用它证明当前模型处理未见样本的表现。
q.en: B errors were used to change the current weights. Calling the file test does not make it independent evidence for unseen cases.

r.zh: 丙来自目标新仓库，答案在模型版本冻结之后才向评估员开放，且未用于调整本次模型。它是本题中独立且用途相符的评价证据；仍不保证以后所有情况。
r.en: C comes from the target warehouse; answers were released to evaluators after the model version was frozen and were not used to fit it. It is independent, use-relevant evidence here, not a guarantee for every future case.
